svg.title: My read-only server proved it can't write. Nobody proved it can't read your laptop
svg.desc: A sealed read-only filesystem box with a single unbroken pipe leading inward, a heavy padlock on the write side, and a hairline crack on the read side where an unseen tap has already been inserted. Trace Bloom generative banner for “My read-only server proved it can't write. Nobody proved it can't read your laptop”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2301991449.
